about: Typical sowing dates (MM-DD) per region and crop: the last fallback for a season record's sowing date (RFC §6.4, source 'regional'). Agronomic rules of thumb for the demo regions only; verify: true until checked against K-State / UNL / CSU planting guides. Autumn dates (Sep–Nov) belong to the next harvest year. v2 adds `windows`: the recommended sowing window per region and crop, [from, to] as MM-DD, with the same season rule as `sowing` (windows starting in Aug-Dec belong to the next harvest year; a window whose end is before its start runs into the next year). Rules of thumb written by the team, not read from a table: verify true until checked against the extension guides listed in data/crop-phenology.json.
